propositions: A Jira DC verification oracle is needed because no DC license/trial and no official OpenAPI spec exist, so a DC adapter cannot be verified except by a real instance.
The harness must vendor a Dockerfile that FROMs the addono base by digest and reproduces the pycontribs wrapper, building locally rather than pulling the unpublished pycontribs/jira-test-image tag.

The image does not contain Jira; atlas-run downloads ~900 artifacts from maven.atlassian.com at runtime, making network egress a hard runtime dependency and Jira version pinning impossible via the image digest.
Removing -DskipAllPrompts=true breaks every cold start via the retired Marketplace v1 endpoint, and a TTY (tty/stdin_open) is required or AMPS exits.

On emulated arm64 hosts Cargo's default 600000ms deploy watchdog kills Jira before boot finishes, so the entrypoint must raise the startup/cargo timeout and a native-amd64 runner is required for practical use.

Tests must live under tests/external/ (auto-marked external, fenced off from make test), use a PAT via Authorization: Bearer, and verify teardown by polling direct issue endpoints for 404 rather than search per ADR 0037.
